sha256_confusion_root_cause: The pre-deployment prompt specified SHA256 0b296996... as the EXP_DRIVE_11 checkpoint. However, 0b296996... is the SHA256 of EXP_DRIVE_08B_best_checkpoint.pt — the base model that EXP_DRIVE_11 depends on. EXP_DRIVE_11 itself is only a 27-param gate head (8593 bytes) with SHA256 9ef77e6b... The confusion originated from: the pre-deployment audit incorrectly assumed EXP_DRIVE_11_best_checkpoint.pt would embed/include a copy of the EXP08B base model weights. It does not — it stores only the 27-parameter gate_state_dict.
verdict_detail: EXP_DRIVE_11 is a secondary research gate that sits on top of the frozen EXP_DRIVE_08B backbone. Neither EXP_DRIVE_11 nor EXP_DRIVE_08B can be deployed from raw video alone. The correct production model is EXP_23_C — pure visual, raw-video deployable, already correctly installed in the SPARK backend. No model replacement is needed.
recommended_next_action: No checkpoint modification required. No model replacement required. EXP_23_C remains the correct production model. The prior deployment blocker was based on a false expectation that EXP_DRIVE_11 would match the SHA256 of EXP_DRIVE_08B. This expectation was incorrect. DEPLOYMENT UNBLOCKED.
